name: es-foral-corporate-tax-credits
description: Calculate the 2026 corporate tax credits of an ordinary trading company under Bizkaia, Álava, Gipuzkoa or Navarra law. Covers investment, R&D and innovation, employment and employer-pension credits, Navarra financing of R&D, foreign-tax credits and carries, conciliation-plan, women and under-36 hiring, preferred EPSV contributions, commuter bicycles and charging points, environmental investment with the grant reduction that differs by territory, new or recent SME share investment and silver-economy training. Use for deducciones del Impuesto sobre Sociedades foral, I+D+i, deducción por creación de empleo, EPSV, inversiones medioambientales, Hacienda Foral and Navarra corporate credits. Load es-foral-corporate-tax first for the governing law, the base, rates, minimum taxation and the credit sequence. Split unchanged from es-foral-corporate-tax on 6 November 2026.
